meta.title: The Boaz Formation Binder
meta.subtitle: A Character Development Program for Sons of the FULFILLED Father

letters.question: Do I keep my word to God and to people?
Do I seek wisdom before I act?
Do I choose others before myself?
Do I bring life and adventure to my people?
Do I live on purpose or just drift?
Do I actually hear what people are saying?
Do I step up when it matters?
Do I build others up or tear them down?
Am I passing on what I've been given?

ranks.requirement: Complete all 9 pillars + all bonus challenges

tracks.name: Cadets
tracks.philosophy: Dad leads. Son follows. Play-based, adventure-heavy, relationship-first.

challenges.name: Psalm Memorizer
challenges.description: Memorize Psalm 23 word for word
challenges.completion: Recite it to dad without any help

challenges.name: Prayer Captain
challenges.description: Lead the family in prayer before dinner every night for 1 week

challenges.name: Keeper of My Word
challenges.description: Make a promise to someone in your family and keep it — no reminders

challenges.name: Morning Soldier
challenges.description: Wake up and do a 5-minute devotion (read a verse + pray) for 14 days straight
challenges.completion: Dad signs off on each morning

challenges.name: Faithful Artist
challenges.description: Draw or build something that represents what faith means to you
challenges.completion: Explain it to the family — no wrong answers

challenges.name: Story Keeper
challenges.description: Interview Grandpa, Grandma, or an elder about their life. Write down 5 things you learned

challenges.name: Book Report Boss
challenges.description: Read a book on your own and tell dad the 3 best things you learned from it

challenges.name: Hero Hunt
challenges.description: Pick a historical hero and research them. Tell the family

challenges.name: Problem Solver
challenges.description: Find a problem in the house and fix it

challenges.name: Wise Questions
challenges.description: Sit with dad for 30 minutes and ask him the best questions you can think of. Write down his answers
challenges.completion: Keep the notes in your binder

challenges.name: Letter Writer
challenges.description: Handwrite a letter to Mom, Dad, and one other family member telling them why you love them

challenges.name: Invisible Servant
challenges.description: Do 3 chores without being asked, without telling anyone, for one full week
challenges.completion: Mom or Dad notices and confirms

challenges.name: Homemade Gift
challenges.description: Make a gift for Mom with your own hands — no buying

challenges.name: Neighbor Check
challenges.description: With dad, bring something to a neighbor or someone in need

challenges.name: Serve Together
challenges.description: Volunteer at a food pantry, shelter, or church service project with dad

challenges.name: Game Night General
challenges.description: Plan and run a family game night — you pick the games, set up, keep score

challenges.name: Build With Dad
challenges.description: Build something with dad — birdhouse, fort, slingshot, anything with tools
challenges.completion: Dad signs off on the build

challenges.name: Outdoor Adventure
challenges.description: Go on a 2-mile hike with dad. No phones for either of you

challenges.name: New Skill Unlock
challenges.description: Learn a new game, sport, or physical skill and show it to dad

challenges.name: Camp Out
challenges.description: Sleep outside with dad for one night. Build a fire if possible
challenges.completion: Full overnight — dad's call on fire

challenges.name: Goal Getter
challenges.description: Set one goal, write it down, and achieve it within 30 days

challenges.name: Daily Routine Maker
challenges.description: Create a morning OR bedtime routine and stick to it for 2 weeks

challenges.name: Chef Apprentice
challenges.description: Learn to make one full meal from scratch (with dad's help) and make it for the family

challenges.name: Plant a Seed
challenges.description: Plant something and care for it until it grows

challenges.name: Time Map
challenges.description: Write out how you spend your day. Find one thing to cut and one thing to add
challenges.completion: Show dad your map and your changes

challenges.name: Story Without Interruption
challenges.description: Listen to dad tell a story or share about his day — no interruptions, full attention

challenges.name: Interview & Remember
challenges.description: Interview someone in your family. Write down exactly what they said. Read it back to them

challenges.name: Quiet in Nature
challenges.description: Sit outside alone in silence for 10 minutes. Write down everything you heard

challenges.name: Double-Check
challenges.description: For one full week, before responding to any instruction from a parent, repeat back what they said

challenges.name: God Listening
challenges.description: Sit in silence for 5 minutes after prayer every day for 7 days. Write anything you sense

challenges.name: Family Devotion
challenges.description: Lead the family in a 5-minute devotion (pick a verse, read it, say what it means)

challenges.name: Team Captain
challenges.description: Be the captain in a group game and lead well

challenges.name: Younger Kid Mentor
challenges.description: Spend 30 minutes teaching a younger kid something you know

challenges.name: Household Manager
challenges.description: Run the house for one morning — make breakfast, keep order, check on everyone

challenges.name: Organize a Cleanup
challenges.description: Plan and lead a yard or room cleanup — recruit helpers, assign jobs

challenges.name: Note Drop
challenges.description: Write 5 encouraging notes and secretly leave them for family members

challenges.name: Daily Kind Word
challenges.description: Say one specific, genuine compliment to a different person every day for 1 week

challenges.name: Biggest Fan
challenges.description: At a sibling's event or game, be the loudest, most enthusiastic supporter

challenges.name: Pick-Me-Up
challenges.description: When someone in the house is sad or struggling, do something to encourage them without being asked

challenges.name: Encouragement Journal
challenges.description: Keep a journal for 14 days noting one person you encouraged each day

challenges.name: Verse Teacher
challenges.description: Teach Shiloh (or a younger child) one Bible verse from memory

challenges.name: Faith Story Share
challenges.description: Tell a friend or cousin about something God has done for you or your family

challenges.name: Prayer Partner
challenges.description: Pray with the same person every day for 7 days

challenges.name: Sunday School Relay
challenges.description: After church, teach your family one thing you learned in Sunday school for 4 weeks straight

challenges.name: Make a Disciple Move
challenges.description: With dad's help, do something intentional to bring someone closer to Jesus

tracks.name: Rangers
tracks.philosophy: Real challenges — physical, financial, relational, technical. No fluff. No participation trophies. You earn everything here.
tracks.note_for_dad: Lead with the warrior framing, not the devotional one. Physical, financial, and technology challenges are your hook.

challenges.name: 30-Day Journal
challenges.description: Journal for 30 consecutive days — at least one paragraph per day. Honest thoughts only
challenges.completion: Dad reads it at the end (you can redact personal pages)

challenges.name: Psalm Warrior
challenges.description: Memorize Psalm 1 AND Psalm 27 in full
challenges.completion: Recite both from memory to dad

challenges.name: Prayer Anchor
challenges.description: Lead the family in prayer every single night for 7 days

challenges.name: 24-Hour Fast
challenges.description: Fast from food for 24 hours. Spend time praying during the fast
challenges.completion: Completed with dad's knowledge and blessing

challenges.name: Faith Under Fire
challenges.description: Have an honest conversation with a friend or family member about what you believe and why

challenges.name: Book & Teach
challenges.description: Read a non-fiction book. Give a 10-minute presentation to the family
challenges.completion: Family gets value from your presentation

challenges.name: Veteran Interview
challenges.description: Interview a veteran, first responder, or elder (non-family). Ask about their life, sacrifices, lessons

challenges.name: Teach What You Don't Know
challenges.description: Pick a topic you know nothing about, research it for 2 weeks, then teach it to dad
challenges.completion: Dad scores your depth of knowledge

challenges.name: Hard Question
challenges.description: Ask dad or a mentor the question you've been afraid to ask. Write down the answer

challenges.name: Worldview Study
challenges.description: Study one other worldview and understand how to respond to it biblically
challenges.completion: Defend a Christian response to dad in a mock conversation

challenges.name: Letters to Family
challenges.description: Handwrite a personal letter to Mom, Dad, Gideon, and Shiloh — one each

challenges.name: Shelter Serve
challenges.description: Volunteer at a homeless shelter, food bank, or community service organization
challenges.completion: One full service event — minimum 3 hours

challenges.name: Invisible Upgrade
challenges.description: Without being asked, mow a neighbor's lawn, shovel their driveway, or do something for someone outside the family — no payment

challenges.name: Check on Your Boys
challenges.description: Reach out to a friend who's struggling — not just a text, a real conversation

challenges.name: 30-Day Love Language Experiment
challenges.description: Learn Mom's and Dad's love languages. Speak each one intentionally every day for 30 days
challenges.completion: Parents notice and confirm the change

challenges.name: Expedition
challenges.description: Plan and execute a camping/hiking trip with dad. You plan the route, pack the gear, lead the navigation
challenges.completion: Trip completed — dad grades your planning

challenges.name: Build Something Real
challenges.description: Build something with your hands — woodworking project, electronics kit, mechanical repair, anything physical

challenges.name: Pass It Down
challenges.description: Teach Shiloh a skill or game you love. Spend 30+ minutes with her doing it

challenges.name: Physical Peak
challenges.description: Complete a physical challenge: a 5K run, a ruck (20 lbs for 3 miles), 100 pushups in a day, or a swim mile

challenges.name: 30-Day Fitness Block
challenges.description: Follow a training plan for 30 consecutive days (pushups, runs, weights — your design)
challenges.completion: Log every day. Before + after measurement

challenges.name: Annual Goals
challenges.description: Set 3 goals for this year (one spiritual, one physical, one practical). Write them down + your plan
challenges.completion: Dad reviews and approves the plan

challenges.name: Save $100
challenges.description: Set a savings goal of $100 and hit it through work, side jobs, or discipline — no handouts

challenges.name: Screen Detox
challenges.description: Go 30 days with intentional screen limits (you set the rules, dad approves them). Track daily
challenges.completion: Log every day. Dad checks weekly

challenges.name: Build a Morning Routine
challenges.description: Design and execute a consistent morning routine for 21 days straight

challenges.name: Budget a Big Purchase
challenges.description: Want something that costs $50+? Build a budget to earn it, save for it, and buy it without asking parents

challenges.name: Three Generations Interview
challenges.description: Interview three people from different generations. Ask the same 5 questions. Compare their answers

challenges.name: Active Listening Challenge
challenges.description: In every conversation for one week, practice active listening: don't interrupt, ask a follow-up question, summarize back what you heard
challenges.completion: Dad or a family member grades your listening

challenges.name: Silence Practice
challenges.description: Spend 15 minutes in silence and solitude every day for 14 days — no phone, no music, just thinking + praying

challenges.name: Sit With Someone
challenges.description: Find someone who's lonely or going through something hard. Sit with them. Don't fix it — just listen

challenges.name: Listening Prayer Journal
challenges.description: For 21 days, spend 5 minutes after prayer just sitting quietly. Write down anything that comes to mind
challenges.completion: Journal entries — share highlights with dad

challenges.name: Lead Family Devotions
challenges.description: Lead a family devotion every week for one month (4 total). Pick the passage, prepare something to say

challenges.name: Neighborhood Cleanup
challenges.description: Organize a neighborhood or local cleanup. Recruit at least 2 people. You run it

challenges.name: Mentor Move
challenges.description: Identify a boy younger than you and invest in him. Hang out, teach him something, check on him — 3 intentional interactions
challenges.completion: Dad interviews you + the kid if possible

challenges.name: Conflict Resolution
challenges.description: Resolve a real conflict between people (not involving you as a main party) — mediate it
challenges.completion: Dad verifies the situation was real and handled well

challenges.name: Project Captain
challenges.description: Plan and lead any project from start to finish with other people involved
challenges.completion: Project complete, documented start to finish

challenges.name: 10 Handwritten Notes
challenges.description: Write 10 genuine, specific encouragement notes to people in your life

challenges.name: The Hard Encouragement
challenges.description: Encourage someone who is going through a genuinely hard situation
challenges.completion: Tell dad the story. He grades your depth

challenges.name: Teammate Builder
challenges.description: In any team setting, make it your mission to build up your teammates consistently for one month
challenges.completion: Team or coach notices and confirms

challenges.name: Brag on Your Family
challenges.description: In a public setting, say something specific and genuine to honor your mom or dad

challenges.name: Monthly Check-In Accountability
challenges.description: Ask a friend or family member to keep you accountable to one goal for 3 months. Check in weekly

challenges.name: Lead a Younger Boy
challenges.description: Identify a younger boy (8-12). Lead him through a devotion or Bible study at least 3 times

challenges.name: Testimony Written
challenges.description: Write your faith testimony — what you believe and why. At least 500 words
challenges.completion: Dad reads it. Then you share it with one person

challenges.name: Technology for Good
challenges.description: Build something with technology that serves a real purpose — an app, a website, a bot, a tool

challenges.name: Share the Gospel
challenges.description: Have a genuine conversation with a non-Christian friend about faith. Not a debate — a real conversation

challenges.name: Disciple One
challenges.description: Pick one person and intentionally pour into them spiritually for 90 days — regular check-ins, prayer, conversation
challenges.completion: Dad interviews you about the relationship at 90 days

recruit_oath: I commit to this not because it's easy, but because easy doesn't build men. I will be faithful when I don't feel like it. I will seek to understand before I react. I will choose others before myself. I will bring life wherever I go. I will live on purpose, not by accident. I will actually listen. I will step up, not step back. I will build people up, not tear them down. I will pass on what I've been given. I am a son of a FULFILLED Father. And I'm just getting started.
